Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 141. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Dark Kamehameha
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (100 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
The form of the kamehameha that Goku Black used.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 100 foot long line must make a
dexterity saving throw dealing 8d10 damage on a fail,
half on a success.
